intro: The MM2H and DE Rantau programmes offer long-term visas for remote workers and investors. English is everywhere, the climate is tropical, and the infrastructure is world-class.
climate: Equatorial: hot and humid year-round at +27-32°C. Two rainy seasons bring short tropical downpours.
mentality: A multicultural society (Malays, Chinese, Indians). Tolerance and a baseline of politeness. Muslim traditions are central to public life.
language_note: Malay is the official language, but English is in effect the language of business, schools, healthcare and most services.
visa_note: Up to 30 days without a visa. DE Rantau is a one-year visa for nomads (income from $24,000). MM2H is a long-term visa for investors (a deposit from 1 million ringgit).
